title: IPv4 and IPv6 firewall coverage
intent: Explain why IPv6 firewall policy must be reviewed when IPv6 is enabled or present in the network design.
evidence: MikroTik documents separate IPv4 and IPv6 firewall filter menus and provides IPv6 filter examples for protecting the router and LAN clients.
The documentation states that in common IPv6 setups clients can be publicly reachable, making appropriate firewall filtering important.
